project_type: Greenfield Laravel 11 monolith — Blade views (no SPA), vanilla JS per-page, MySQL InnoDB, file-based cache/sessions for InfinityFree shared hosting
language: PHP 8.2 (backend), JavaScript ES6+ (frontend, no bundler — plain <script> tags)
build_system: Composer for PHP deps, no Node/npm build step. All JS/CSS served as static files from public/. Run `composer install --no-dev` for production. Laravel artisan handles migrations, seeding, key generation, route/view/config caching.
test_framework: No test suite specified; use `php artisan migrate --pretend` and `php artisan route:list` for structural verification. Add PHPUnit tests only if explicitly requested.
build_command: composer install --no-dev && php artisan key:generate --no-interaction && php artisan optimize
test_command: php artisan route:list && php artisan migrate --pretend
verification_instructions: 1. `php artisan --version` must output Laravel 11.x. 2. `php artisan migrate --pretend` must exit 0 (all 15 migration files parsed without error). 3. `php artisan route:list` must show all web + api routes with correct middleware. 4. `php artisan optimize` must exit 0. 5. For seeder: `php artisan db:seed --pretend` or with live DB `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: vendor/ (composer install), storage/app/documents/ (runtime, gitignored), bootstrap/cache/*.php (php artisan optimize). None are checked in.
environment_constraints: InfinityFree shared hosting: no Redis, no queue workers, no cron daemon, no SSH exec. Use CACHE_DRIVER=file, SESSION_DRIVER=file, QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync. PHP 8.2 available. MySQL 5.7+ available. FTP deploy only — no SSH. public/.htaccess must handle mod_rewrite for Laravel routing.
contribution_requirements: All money as decimal(8,2) KSh. Phone format 07XXXXXXXX. OTP hashed (SHA-256) in DB. ID numbers encrypted with Crypt::encrypt(). Admin = is_admin flag on users table. No JWT — session cookies + CSRF. Webhook endpoints must be excluded from CSRF middleware. Document filenames: {slug}-{token}.pdf / .docx.
key_patterns: Controllers live in app/Http/Controllers/. Services in app/Services/ (AfricasTalkingService, PayHeroService, TelegramService, DocumentService, StorageService). Middleware in app/Http/Middleware/. Models in app/Models/. All DB interaction via Eloquent (no raw queries except FULLTEXT search). Blade views in resources/views/ with layouts/app.blade.php as master layout. JS files one-per-page in public/js/. CSS in public/css/app.css. JSON schema field types: text, textarea, date, select, phone, email, number.
directory_structure: Standard Laravel 11 layout. app/Http/Controllers/ — all controllers. app/Services/ — business logic services. app/Models/ — 13 Eloquent models. app/Http/Middleware/ — AuthMiddleware + AdminMiddleware. database/migrations/ — 15 migration files. database/seeders/ — DatabaseSeeder, CategorySeeder, TemplateSeeder. resources/views/ — Blade views (layouts/, errors/, library/, admin/). public/ — static assets (css/, js/, assets/, manifest.json, sw.js, .htaccess). routes/ — web.php + api.php. config/ — services.php, cache.php. .github/workflows/ — deploy.yml.
